newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ActivCard plans $30 mln IPO, Easdaq listing.
newsitem.headline: ActivCard plans $30 mln IPO, Easdaq listing.

text.p: French "smart card" maker ActivCard SA said on Monday it planned to raise some $30 million through an initital public offering of shares.
In a statement received in Amsterdam it said it also planned to seek a listing on Easdaq, a new European stock exchange for high-tech firms modelled on Nasdaq in the U.S.
ActivCard said the shares would be sold by means of public offerings in Belgium and France and a private placement among institutional investors in Britain and other European countries.
ActivCard makes electronic identity cards which prevent unauthorised users from gaining access to computer and telecommunications networks.
The company said it would use the proceeds of the share offering to expand and meet the growing demand for its cards.
